profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I build reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, fix AI-generated messes, and solve business problems.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Worked on AI integrations into Optimantra as a senior engineer. Performed code reviews, led the maintenance team, provided technical mentorship, and helped translate business goals into team objectives. 


Accomplishments:
Built the back-end logic powering their health metrics feature, querying and bucketing data in AWS Timestream based on selections in the UI
Partnered with Cerbo as part of joint AI efforts, integrating with their existing AI infrastructure to for Optimantra’s AI Scribe feature 
Successfully completed the MainSail Gauntlet AI accelerator as part of the inaugural cohort
Built a Python PoC AWS Bedrock integration to pre-fill patient questionnaires and parse explanation of benefits documents to allow practitioners to save time on pre-visit paperwork
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development

positions.title: IT Sr Technical Specialist
positions.description:
Worked on the Patient Portal application as a senior engineer, focusing on the patient billing and payments experience. Performed code reviews, designed the AWS architecture for new functionality, mentored junior developers towards best practices for maintainable software, worked with business and product leadership to refine requirements into features. 


Accomplishments:
Helped re-work the appointment scheduling and staffing Spring Boot back-end systems, writing logic for calculating staff capacity scheduled at locations, and adjusting capacity based on scheduling changes, encouraging more appointment scheduling over walk-in testing
Integrated Patient Portal’s Spring Boot back-end with Labcorp’s enterprise payment service, enabling patients to pay bills online via Patient Portal
Helped integrate Patient Portal with a company-wide “bad debt” initiative, enabling links between reminder messages to follow through on unpaid invoices to the Patient Portal, so patients can pay online, including deep linking to their invoice after scanning a QR code. This helped Labcorp recoup revenue from Covid.
Updated a testing reminder program to allow business users to define their own reminder email programs, along with criteria for determining which orders qualified for reminders using DynamoDB, Lambda, and SQS. Initial results showed a 7% increase in appointments, from patients who were most likely to skip this testing altogether. 
Built Splunk dashboards to track effectiveness of Patient Portal systems
Wrote Terraform modules to define and manage our AWS infrastructure, enabling faster iteration and easier experimentation
Helped rewrite the service center location management and online appointment scheduling experience, updating from Java 8 to 17 and using Spring Boot, Docker, ECS, Postgres, and DynamoDB, letting us take advantage of new Java features to improve application performance
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · JavaScript · AngularJS · TypeScript · SQL · Terraform

positions.title: Professional Services Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Labcorp patient team to build a service to help improve the user experience of their Patient Portal application 


Accomplishments:
Worked with LabCorp to build a service to monitor the health of external dependencies relied on by their Patient Portal consumer application using Postman’s Node.js SDK
Built a REST API for interacting with the service, using API Gateway, Java, and Lambda functions
Built deployment automation using AWS CloudFormation and then Terraform
Integrated this deployment automation with a new, internal Jenkins-based continuous integration and deliverability pipeline
Taught myself Angular (version 8, later upgraded to 11, currently upgrading to 19) to build a simple UI/admin console for demo purposes
Wrote automated unit tests to ensure thorough test coverage
Integrated a lambda function written in Node.js into a Maven Java project holding the associated RESTful API so all code can be built and tested at once

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and build custom solutions for customers as well as proofs of concepts for potential customers.

* Developed expertise in Bloomreach’s Hippo CMS, converting an existing sales demo site into a customizable demo that could switch between customers with only a configuration change
* Helped develop pieces of the frontend demo store for the commercetools Blueprint framework using Vue.js
* Developed custom extensions for comercetools’s product Merchant Center (written in React)
* Worked with Sales to skin commercetools’s demo storefront, Sunrise, for salesdemos to make the store match their existing web stores
* Wrote Python scripts to import products into Merchant Center for sales demos

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Became a Bronto certified specialist.

* Primary developer and maintainer Socialite, a social network integration for Bronto

* Wrote a Chrome extension to support our Browse Recovery application, enabling sales to demo the applications functionality to clients, services to configure the application for customers, and support to test settings and help customers debug configuration problems

* Wrote a Hive script to analyze events with our Popup Manager application so Marketing can see submission rates, and filter this data by industry, month, and even see breakdowns by display type while being able to see a per-popup breakdown so they can identify top-performing popups

* Lead developer on an application that automated kitchen duty for Bronto employees

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer developing and maintaining custom code designed to tag video metadata to help fuel video discovery.

Accomplishments:

* Learned Python

* Took over support and development for the Tribune Media Service API and led development from versions 1.0 to current version in production today.

* Wrote a Python web service to serve as the back-end of a live-tagging application for the 2012 Summer Olympics

* Combined data from multiple sources to map clips from episode reel transcripts to EDL files to map metadata for scenes used in affiliate clip portals to make promos for the shows Two and a Half Men, Friends, The Big Bang Theory, and The Middle.

* Automated a previously manual process of aggregating Varnish access log data, generating rolling 7- and 30-day SLA reports every day.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Java software maintenance and development. Developing and maintaining report templates in Jasper's iReport, as well as ad hoc reports on JasperServer.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
I worked in development and maintenance for Intergy, a POMIS application for doctors and health care providers.

I worked extensively with financial reporting, creating 2 practice-level financial reports. I also laid the groundwork for exporting report-data to XML for clients to use this data in 3rd-party applications.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I taught recitation lectures for a computer literacy course for both Mac and Windows sections. My focus was on Microsoft Office and iLife.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Helped students master material in homework assignments and prepare for tests. Documented visits to their professors for records that students were seeking help outside of class.

projects.title: Campus Navigator
projects.description: Google Maps application for getting walking directions on a college campus.
